theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

top_news.title: US Bond-Market Slide Deepens, Pushing Yields to Two-Decade Highs
top_news.summary: The losses in the US Treasuries market intensified on Wednesday as robust economic data and a weak debt auction drove yields across most maturities to the highest levels in almost two decades.

top_news.title: Asian Bonds Drop on Inflation Jitters as Oil Gains: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian bonds fell, tracking losses on Wall Street as rising oil prices and stronger-than-expected US economic data fueled inflation concerns and bets on further interest-rate hikes. The yen, near a three-week low, will be in focus as Japanese markets reopen.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 24
top_news.summary: Oil held a gain on renewed tensions between the US and Iran, with a defiant message from President Masoud Pezeshkian highlighting the still-wide gap between the two sides after months of war in the Middle East.

top_news.title: AI Rally, Weaker Yen Set the Stage for Japan’s Market Return
top_news.summary: Japanese stocks look poised to catch up with a global AI-led rally when trading resumes on Thursday, while a weaker yen keeps currency intervention risk in focus.

top_news.title: Former SEC Regulator on Private Market Access
top_news.summary: Kirkland and Ellis Partner Alpa Patel sat down with Bloomberg's Romaine Bostick from the Financial Markets Quality Conference at Georgetown University to discuss the state of the private markets, and the regulatory framework around opening access to the public. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: IAEA Director on Nuclear Material Left in Iran
top_news.summary: IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi joins Bloomberg's David Bura at the UNGA to discuss the nuclear situation in Iran. He says there is still a fairly important amount of nuclear material in Iran and that the IAEA can get on the ground and assess pretty fast if there is the political will for it.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: IAEA's Grossi Says Iran Nuclear Inspections Can Resume Fast
top_news.summary: IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi joins Bloomberg's David Gura at the United Nations General Assembly to discuss the nuclear situation in Iran. He says there is still a fairly important amount of nuclear material in Iran and that the IAEA can get on the ground and assess pretty fast if there is the political will for it. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: How David Booth Built Dimensional From A Brooklyn Brownstone
top_news.summary: David Booth started Dimensional Fund Advisors out of a Brooklyn brownstone in 1981 with an idea that challenged conventional investing: investors should have exposure to smaller companies as part of a diversified portfolio. More than four decades later, Dimensional manages over $1 trillion. Booth is on this week's episode of The David Rubenstein Show: Peer to Peer Conversations to discuss how he built Dimensional and the investment philosophy behind the firm. This interview was recorded August 1

top_news.title: Citigroup Sets Up Paramount Loan Calls as Banks Prepare to Sell Debt
top_news.summary: Citigroup Inc. will kick off meetings with loan investors on Thursday for Paramount Skydance Corp. as banks prepare to sell debt to fund its takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc.

top_news.title: Venezuela Spot Oil Sales Snarled by Surging Freight Costs
top_news.summary: Sales of Venezuelan oil for loading in October stalled after a surge in shipping costs muddled negotiations between the country’s state oil company and buyers of its oil.
